Specification.In the Box: CMF Speaker S, Quick Start Guide
Specification.Audio Features: Wide Soundstage, Ultra Bass, Custom EQ, Night Mode
Specification.Fast Charging: 10-minute charge provides up to 1 hour of playback
Specification.Playback Time: Up to 18 hours with AAC playback, Ultra Bass on, and 50% volume
Specification.Party Mode: Press the Auracast button to turn Party Mode on/off
Specification.Hard Reset: Press and hold the power button for 10 seconds
Specification.Knob – Ultra Bass: Press and hold for 2 seconds to toggle on/off
Specification.Factory Reset: Press and hold the Bluetooth button for 8 seconds
Specification.Audio Source Switching: Press the Bluetooth button to switch between USB-C and Bluetooth audio when USB-C audio is connected
Specification.Battery Level: Front LED white when battery is at least 15%
Specification.Charging: Front LED breathes white; breathes red when battery is below 15%
Specification.Power Standby: Front LED flashes white: 0.5 seconds on, 2 seconds off
Specification.Factory Reset Successful: Rear LED flashes blue three times rapidly, then the speaker restarts
